# @uptimizr/web-export

> The shared foundation for Uptimizr's web-export engine connectors (Unity, Godot, Unreal —
> ADR 0045). These engines render into a `<canvas>` from WebAssembly, so there is no live JS scene
> to read: a JS-only tier captures pointer heatmaps / FPS / errors with no engine code, and a thin
> engine-side shim pushes pose, picks, perf and a scene proxy over a tiny versioned bridge. All
> schema mapping and coordinate normalization stay in TypeScript.

## Docs

- [Package reference](./README.md): when to use it directly, the two tiers, `trackWebExport`, the bridge contract.
- [Agent guide](./AGENTS.md): rules and canonical usage for AI agents.
- [Web-export guide](https://uptimizr.com/docs/connectors/web-export/): the docs-site walkthrough.
- [Integration & API reference](https://github.com/RaananW/Uptimizr/blob/main/docs/integration.md): track and query the data (see "Web-export engines").
- [Architecture Decision Records](https://github.com/RaananW/Uptimizr/tree/main/docs/adr): privacy model (0003), coordinate frame & connector provenance (0018), web-export engine connectors (0045).

## Engine packages built on this

- [`@uptimizr/unity`](../unity/README.md) — left-handed, y-up, meters (already canonical).
- [`@uptimizr/godot`](../godot/README.md) — right-handed, y-up, meters (negate Z).
- [`@uptimizr/unreal`](../unreal/README.md) — left-handed, z-up, centimeters (rebase + rescale).

## Key exports

- `trackWebExport(options)` — one-call setup; returns `{ client, bridge }` (`WebExportSession`).
- `webExportCollector(options)` — the combined sdk-core collector (JS-only tier + engine bridge).
- `createEngineBridge(options)`, `EngineBridge`, `BRIDGE_PROTOCOL_VERSION` — the versioned bridge contract.
- `startJsOnlyCapture(options)` — the bare zero-engine-code tier (pointer, rAF FPS/long frames, JS errors).
- `normalizePosition`, `normalizeDirection`, `normalizeAabb`, `rebaseZUpToYUp` — native → canonical frame.
- `buildConnector(...)`, `buildSceneProxy(...)` — `session_start` provenance and the scene proxy.
- Types: `NativeFrame`, `TrackWebExportOptions`, `WebExportSession`, `WebExportCollectorOptions`, `CanvasView`, `JsOnlyOptions`, `JsOnlyCaptureOptions`, `BridgeSceneNode`.
